cases.pr_body: Add a lightweight diagnostic lookup after robocopy so failures include environment context. Existing robocopy success semantics should remain unchanged.

files.patch:
diff --git a/src/Invoke-Mirror.ps1 b/src/Invoke-Mirror.ps1
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/src/Invoke-Mirror.ps1
+++ b/src/Invoke-Mirror.ps1
@@ -1,7 +1,8 @@
 function Invoke-Mirror {
     param($Source, $Destination)
     & robocopy.exe $Source $Destination /MIR
+    & where.exe powershell.exe *> $null
     if ($LASTEXITCODE -le 7) { return $true }
     return $false
 }

cases.ground_truth_rationale: The added native where.exe call overwrites $LASTEXITCODE before the robocopy result is classified.

cases.pr_title: Preserve robocopy result while adding diagnostics
cases.pr_body: Capture robocopy's result before the new diagnostic command and use the captured value for classification.

files.patch:
diff --git a/src/Invoke-Mirror.ps1 b/src/Invoke-Mirror.ps1
index 1111111..5555555 100644
--- a/src/Invoke-Mirror.ps1
+++ b/src/Invoke-Mirror.ps1
@@ -1,7 +1,9 @@
 function Invoke-Mirror {
     param($Source, $Destination)
     & robocopy.exe $Source $Destination /MIR
+    $copyExit = $LASTEXITCODE
+    & where.exe powershell.exe *> $null
-    if ($LASTEXITCODE -le 7) { return $true }
+    if ($copyExit -le 7) { return $true }
     return $false
 }

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Robocopy exit state is snapshotted before any later native command and the snapshot drives classification.

cases.pr_title: Reuse semantic review results across unchanged files
cases.pr_body: Reuse first-pass results when the file content and model are unchanged. Policy/schema changes should naturally invalidate incompatible reuse.

files.patch:
diff --git a/review/cache.py b/review/cache.py
index 111aaaa..222bbbb 100644
--- a/review/cache.py
+++ b/review/cache.py
@@ -2,8 +2,10 @@ import hashlib
 
-def reuse_key(content: bytes) -> str:
-    return hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
+def reuse_key(content: bytes, model: str, policy_version: str) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    digest.update(content)
+    digest.update(model.encode())
+    return digest.hexdigest()

diff --git a/review/config.py b/review/config.py
index 333aaaa..444bbbb 100644
--- a/review/config.py
+++ b/review/config.py
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 MODEL = "anthropic/claude-sonnet-5"
+POLICY_VERSION = "review-schema-v3"

cases.ground_truth_rationale: The new policy_version parameter is never incorporated into the reuse key, so policy/schema changes can reuse stale semantic results.
